Name: Hay Subscription
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
After nearly a decade of players repeatedly trekking to Marnie's every time their silos are empty, only to find that she's absent, there is now a way to get hay automatically delivered to your silos, every time it empties:
[list]
[*]Get a barn or coop
[*]Get animals
[*]Get a silo
[*]Go to Marnie's Ranch and find the table pictured below:
[/list] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/36718/36718-1755347261-2029188609.jpg[/img]﻿
[list]
[*]Interact with it to start the subscription
[*]Now, every time your silos run out of hay, Marnie will refill them (with a configurable markup on the hay, of course) and you will never have to make the trek to Marnie's again (unless you want to buy animals or cancel the subscription)
[/list][size=4]Compatibility:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with all mods that add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]EAC[/url]﻿ feeds (that Marnie sells): such as [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url] [/b]so that custom feeds will be delivered too. [b]Make sure your Extra Animal Config version is at least 1.8.12 or this mod will not load[/b][/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Works with all mods that change silo capacity[/size]
[*][size=2]Works with all mods that add custom hay-storing buildings[/size]
[*][size=2]Works with all mods that change Hay price (such as [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]SVBO[/url]﻿[/b])[/size]
[*][size=2]Works with all silo retextures[/size]
[*][size=2]Works with all custom animals[/size]
[*][size=2]Should work with most mods that change the map of Marnie's shop (please report any incompatibilities)[/size]
[*][size=2][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿[/b] compatible[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=2]If you'd like to help translate this mod, please leave a comment

If you enjoyed this mod, please endorse it. It means a lot to me and it helps other people find this mod
[/size][url=https://github.com/TechnicalityCreations/StardewMods/tree/master/HaySubscription]SOURCE[/url]
